title: 2007 The gym. No more sports, concerts, ping pong, hot dog sales, campaigns or assemblies, plays etc
description: After the new gym was built in 1959, it quickly became a hub of activity. Early morning practices at 7 a.m., after-school sessions, and special events such as semifinals, tournaments, and track-and-field meets kept the space in constant use. During this era, sports followed strictly seasonal schedules set by the provincial school board, guaranteeing a defined beginning and end for each activity. Competitions were arranged with schools of similar student populations, fostering fair and spirited rivalries. The community’s enthusiasm for events, whether sports games, concerts, variety shows, music festivals, banquets, or graduations, was remarkable, often filling the gym to standing-room-only capacity. Before the new gym was built, the assembly room on the top floor of the original building served as the main gathering place. Additionally, the Legion hall was equipped as a gymnasium, and its higher ceiling made it an alternative venue for basketball games.
